resources.string: Control your PC from this phone
Point the camera at the QR code in the Vibe Coder window on your PC (both on the same Wi-Fi). That connects you — nothing else to do.
or paste the link from the PC window
That link does not look right — it should start with http and contain a token. Easiest: just scan the QR.
This can take a few seconds — a bit longer over mobile data.
The tunnel is up, so the PC itself is not answering. Check that it is switched on, awake, and that the Vibe Coder app is running on it. This app keeps retrying by itself.
No Wi-Fi and no mobile data right now. Turn one of them on — the connection continues by itself the moment the phone is online again.
Turn Tailscale on — on the PC

The home address does not answer, and the PC has not signed in to Tailscale yet, so there is no way in from outside. Open the Vibe Coder window on the PC and finish the Tailscale card there. Then this phone reaches it from anywhere.

The home address does not answer, so the connection has to go through Tailscale — the free tunnel between this phone and your PC — and it is not installed. Install it, sign in with the SAME account as the PC, and come back here: the connection continues by itself.

The home address does not answer — either this phone is on another network, or the PC is asleep. Tailscale, the tunnel that reaches your PC from anywhere, is currently off. Open it, flip the big switch to Connected, and just come back here — the moment the tunnel is up this app reconnects on its own. If it still cannot reach the PC afterwards, the PC itself is off.
Could not open Tailscale from here — open it from the home screen and turn it on.
Unfamiliar Wi-Fi — your PC session is protected by the encrypted tunnel. Still, be careful on public networks.

Ready to tell you the moment an agent on your PC finishes or needs you — even with this app closed. Nothing is being streamed and nothing is being sent; the phone is only listening. Android requires this line to be shown.
This phone has no battery-optimisation screen to open. Look for Battery → Vibe Coder in Settings and allow it to run in the background.
